item.title: FAA ground stop halts all US departures; Duffy blames outdated air traffic technology
item.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said overloaded routers and aging air traffic control systems caused the nationwide ground stop. Some controllers questioned the explanation. Airspace reopened at about 8:15 p.m. Eastern.

item.title: Bessent clashes with Lutnick over chip exports to China
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent pressed Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick over why Nvidia customer Megaspeed had not been added to the entity list. Lutnick reportedly worried the move would escalate trade tensions with Beijing.

item.title: Cruise passengers rescued after tanker slams into ship on Mississippi River
item.description: Dozens of people were hurt when a tanker crashed into a river cruise ship docked in New Orleans. City officials said no one died and all passengers were rescued.
